title: Artifact demonstration
idea: Artifact demonstration: An enlarged genuine tag, label or tool anchors the first field; its relevant use sits beside it.
audience: People who need to inspect artifact within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: The product has recognizable physical proportions that explain its use.
avoidWhen: The object is only a generic mockup unrelated to the claim.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic artifact layout through its inspect artifact priority and explicit commitment contract: Show the selected real variation and its limitations before a purchase or contact action.
navigation: Artifact demonstration keeps the current inspect artifact context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: An enlarged genuine tag, label or tool anchors the first field; its relevant use sits beside it.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to inspect artifact; the product has recognizable physical proportions that explain its use.
composition.priority: Show the selected real variation and its limitations before a purchase or contact action.

imagery.role: Support the actual inspect artifact context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: On phones show the intact artifact before a short explanation, never squeeze its fine print.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the artifact demonstration structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no inspect artifact content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Show the selected real variation and its limitations before a purchase or contact action.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized inspect artifact content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Show the selected real variation and its limitations before a purchase or contact action.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active inspect artifact context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
